articles.author: Lallalit Srijandorn
articles.summary: The Japanese economy contracted 0.4% over the quarter in the third quarter (Q3) of 2025, the preliminary reading released by Japan’s Cabinet Office showed on Monday. This reading came in above the market expectation of a 0.6% decline and the previous reading of a 0.6% expansion (revised from 0.5%).
articles.title: Breaking: Japan’s GDP contracts 0.4% QoQ in Q3 2025 vs -0.6% expected

articles.summary: Gold price (XAU/USD) recovers some lost ground to near $4,105, snapping the two-day losing streak during the early European session on Friday. The precious metal edges higher on the softer US Dollar (USD).  Traders will take more cues from the Fedspeak later on Monday.
articles.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD recovers above $4,100, hawkish Fed might cap gains
